subject.title: fix(repair): let the model choose cluster work

question: Should scheduled repair intake replace deterministic cluster-quality filtering with model-guided selection, and which exclusion gates must remain deterministic outside the model?
rationale: This changes the policy boundary for autonomous repair work rather than repairing an established defect; the repository member-authored change needs explicit maintainer intent on acceptable model discretion.

options.title: Use a bounded hybrid selector
options.body: Keep deterministic exclusion gates for protected, security-sensitive, and clearly non-repairable clusters, then let the model choose at most one remaining candidate.

options.title: Adopt model-only selection
options.body: Accept model judgment as the complete cluster-quality policy while retaining only downstream worker mutation controls.

options.title: Retain deterministic ranking
options.body: Keep the predecessor’s deterministic selector and defer model-guided prioritization until a separate approved policy design exists.

recommendation.title: Use a bounded hybrid selector
recommendation.body: Keep deterministic exclusion gates for protected, security-sensitive, and clearly non-repairable clusters, then let the model choose at most one remaining candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the merged ranking implementation and this replacement proposal, making them the best available source for the intended repair-intake policy and its validation.
